VI.description: An NI-IMAQdx session (ref{GenClassTag.IMAQdx.IMAQdx}) - its control part carries an embedded MNGI image - into a property node of the session's class, read by the category names NI's export writes (Camera Attributes:Display Name). With no camera the node answers an error, which is the observable; the point is that the VI loads and runs.

FreeLabel.comment: Read one attribute of the session

Node.inputs: IMAQdx Session:4200.value,error in (no error):,Camera Attributes\3AActive Attribute:4201.value
Node.outputs: IMAQdx Session:4210.IMAQdx Session,error out:4210.error out,Camera Attributes\3ADisplay Name:4210.DisplayName
